subject.title: chore(deps-dev): bump @testing-library/jest-dom from 6.9.1 to 7.0.0 in the testing group

question: Should this project intentionally raise its minimum supported Node.js version from 20 to 22 in order to accept Jest DOM 7?
rationale: The dependency’s upstream runtime requirement conflicts with the repository’s current published engine range; choosing whether to narrow that range is a support-policy decision, not a mechanical lockfile repair.

options.title: Preserve Node 20 support
options.body: Keep a Node-20-compatible Jest DOM version and regenerate only the compatible lockfile changes.

options.title: Adopt Node 22 minimum
options.body: Raise the repository engine requirement to Node 22 and document and validate the new supported runtime baseline.

recommendation.title: Preserve Node 20 support
recommendation.body: Keep a Node-20-compatible Jest DOM version and regenerate only the compatible lockfile changes.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision changes the repository’s advertised runtime-support policy.
